title: Celsius to Fahrenheit Mapping
description: A temperature field in Celsius maps to Fahrenheit with the standard linear formula. Unit mappings carry their formula and precision, so translations are exact and auditable. Teaching ladder: rank 1 — the concept in its simplest, most direct form.

demo.title: Runnable code demo — Celsius to Fahrenheit Mapping
demo.program:
# Cross-database semantic translation: Celsius to Fahrenheit Mapping
mapping = {"temp_c": "temp_f"}  # rule: F = C * 9/5 + 32
source_record = {"temp_c": "sample-value"}
translated = {mapping[k]: v for k, v in source_record.items()}
print("source:    ", source_record)
print("translated:", translated)
assert translated["temp_f"] == "sample-value"
print("OK - semantic mapping is lossless on the sample")
